sb_prompt: WHAT KIND OF CAR DO YOU THINK YOU MIGHT BUY NEXT?  WHAT SORTS OF THINGS WILL ENTER INTO YOUR DECISION?  SEE IF YOUR REQUIREMENTS AND THE OTHER CALLER'S REQUIREMENTS ARE SIMILAR.
turns: So, what kind of car are you thinking of buying next?
Well, I've been thinking about getting a truck.
A truck, huh? What kind of truck are you interested in?
I'm considering a full-size pickup truck. Maybe something like a Ford F-150 or a Chevrolet Silverado.
Those are great choices! What are some of the things you're looking for in a truck?
I want something with a lot of towing capacity, so I can haul my boat around. I also want a comfortable ride, good fuel economy, and plenty of tech features.
Those are all great requirements! Have you had any experience with trucks before?
Yeah, I've owned a few trucks in the past, but they were all smaller and not as powerful as the ones I'm looking at now. I'm excited to upgrade to something more capable.
That's great to hear! What kind of boat do you usually tow with your truck?
I have a small fishing boat that I like to take out on the lake. It's not too heavy, but it's still a good workout for the truck.
That sounds like a lot of fun! Have you had any issues with your current truck when it comes to towing your boat?

Not really, it's just that I want something with a little more power and towing capacity. My current truck can handle it, but I want something that can make the process a little easier and more comfortable.
I can definitely understand that. What kind of tech features are you looking for in your next truck?
I'm looking for things like a touchscreen infotainment system, a backup camera, and a blind spot monitoring system. I also want a truck with good safety ratings, so I can feel safe on the road.
Those are all great features to have! Have you had a chance to test drive any of the trucks you're interested in yet?
I haven't had a chance to test drive one yet, but I'm planning on doing that soon. I want to see how they handle on the road and how comfortable they are.
That's a great idea! I hope you find the perfect truck for your needs. Thanks for chatting with me about it!
Thanks for chatting with me too! It was nice to discuss this with someone who understands the importance of having a reliable and comfortable truck. Good luck with your search!
